visual_diff.axis_compliance: Axis L compliant: radius 0; angular 2px bezel; no box-shadow, 0 3px 0, or white inset gloss. Feedback uses LCD ghosting and segment flashes.

compared_with.how_it_differs: Ochre isometric blocks and falling slab versus a two-tone LCD, seven-segment HUD, and scan trail.
Risograph rules, press, and ink bleed versus an angular handheld bezel and lit segments/miss marks.
Felt cutting mat, stitches, and fibers versus a sage LCD and black segments without an illustrated background.

strengths: The standards and unit exist, and the core manipulation directly covers layers, projections, counts, and extrema.
At 1280x800 the game uses a real 58:42 split; at 2000px the 1280px stage remains centered without overlap or stretched cards.
Axis L is clearly distinct from the latest three games and no forbidden CSS was detected.
No-input, fixed-cell, and all-on strategies cannot complete the generated decks under the three-miss rule.

must_fix.issue: Seven RT samples do not say which input row is the front. Saying the front appears on the left defines only output order, so both reversed answers are defensible.
must_fix.how: Show a front arrow on an actual grid and state the row convention; generate the choices and screen projection through the same transform.

must_fix.issue: It computes maxima only from POOL3 already capped at total 12. Independent exhaustive checking found 4,266 of 17,319 groups with an understated true maximum.
must_fix.how: Compute extrema over every allowed 0..3 height map first, then exclude groups whose true extrema exceed the intended difficulty range.

must_fix.issue: A different construction satisfying the same projections and minimum/maximum is rejected per layer unless it equals the hidden representative sol.H.
must_fix.how: Judge silhouettes after completion by the three projections, and min/max by projections plus the true total. At intermediate layers check only whether some valid completion remains, or remove intermediate rejection.

must_fix.issue: A missed required lower cell is saved into locked; belowOn then prevents lighting cells above it. On a height-three column one mistake can force the next two misses and game over.
must_fix.how: After feedback repair the layer to the solution or replay it. Keep mistake state separate from the structural floor used to enable the next layer.

must_fix.issue: Fallback distractors are arbitrary pad-near values and can become malformed strings such as (0,0)0,0,3 or duplicate coordinates.
must_fix.how: Require three misconception-derived distractors per type and reject a problem if deduplication leaves fewer than two; validate every output format.

must_fix.issue: The LCD axis is clear, but much of the stimulus pane is empty and the object clusters to one side, especially on tablet.
must_fix.how: Use meaningful LCD scales, layer labels, or well circuitry in the empty area and tune object scale per viewport.

nice_to_have: 38 FPS is close to the threshold; reduce full-canvas redraw and DPR cost.
Replace technical occupancy wording and coordinate strings with textbook-style grids and a front arrow.
verdict: 폐기. 오른쪽 투영 발문이 비유일하고 최소·최대 생성기 및 다해 판정에 수학 오류가 있으며, 한 번의 아래층 실수가 연쇄 미쓰로 회복 불가능해지는 게이트도 위반한다.
